title: From Linear to Nonlinear: A Resolvente criterion for Polynomial Stability of Semigroups Generated by Monotone Operators
summary: The Borichev--Tomilov theorem \cite{BT2010} provides a sharp characterization of polynomial decay for linear $C_0$-semigroups in terms of resolvent growth along the imaginary axis. In the nonlinear setting, the absence of a spectral theory renders the imaginary-axis approach inapplicable.
